sources.label: A collection of font-related Morphe patches to improve readability/accessibility
sources.author: Stylus
patch_list: Custom font (Where is my Train)

Replaces Where is my Train's bundled Google Sans, Nunito Sans, and Roboto UI fonts with a custom font file. Optional OpenType feature settings can enable alternate digits such as Inter's ss01 open-style numbers.
Force system font (Where is my Train)
Renders the app using the device's system font instead of Google Sans / Nunito Sans.

sources.label: 🐈‍⬛ Patches for niche apps
sources.author: Shuhaib
patch_list: Amoled Dark Theme
Changes selected night theme colors to pure black.
Change Accent Color
Changes the accent color throughout the app.
Change Accent Color (Bytecode Dependency)
Applies the selected accent color to the app's bytecode.
Cloud Tower
Adds the preference to fetch tower information from the internet.
Debug Mode
Adds the preference to enable detailed toast messages.
Hide Items From Sidebar
Hides sharing, rating, reporting, feature request, and language options.
Mock Tower
Adds the preference to simulate being on the tower.
Remember Date Selection
Adds the preference to remember the selected date.
Show Running Days in Tracking
Adds the preference to show running days on the tracking page.
Simulate Cell Tower
Adds the preference to simulate the selected train's cell tower.
